Alvaro Castillo, Commissioner  Michele Ware, Commissioner
Michael Clemson, Commissioner

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

At 5:01 PM, Vice Chair Templin called the meeting to order.

ROLL CALL

  Commissioners Present: Templin, Castillo, Clemson, LaFarga, Ware

  Commissioners Absent: Lewis, Gonzalez Edmond

Also present: Alison Spindler-Ruiz, Planning Bureau Manager, Erin Weesner-McKinley, Deputy City
Attorney, Vanessa Hall, City Clerk Specialist.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

Commissioner Clemson led the Pledge of Allegiance.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  23-25744  Recommendation to receive and file Director’s Report.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Clemson, seconded by Commissioner
  Ware, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  4  Templin, Clemson, LaFarga, Ware
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 3  Lewis, Castillo, Gonzalez Edmond

  Alison Spindler-Ruiz, Planning Bureau Manager, Community Development, spoke;
  and provided the Director’s Report.

2.  23-25653  Recommendation to approve the minutes of the Planning Commission meeting on
  Thursday, November 2, 2023.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Ware, seconded by Commissioner

3.  23-25740  Recommendation to accept Categorical Exemption CE-23-133; and

  Approve a Conditional Use Permit (CUP23-015) and adopt the proposed findings
  and conditions of approval thereto, for the operation of a nonprofit preschool within
  a portion of an existing two-story resource center (West Long Beach Facilities
  Center) located in Admiral Kidd Park at 2125 Santa Fe Avenue in the Park (P)
  Zoning District. The project includes the replacement of the existing play
  equipment within the exterior 2,800-square-foot play yard. (District 7)

  A motion was made by Commissioner Clemson, seconded by Commissioner
  Castillo, to approve recommendation, as amended, to [1] rephrase Condition
  of Approval No. 5 to reflect that indoor and outdoor facility operations shall
  comply with Long Beach Municipal Code section 21.52.249 and [2] strike
  condition No. 9b. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  5  Templin, Castillo, Clemson, LaFarga, Ware
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 2  Lewis, Gonzalez Edmond

  Alison Spindler-Ruiz, Planning Bureau Manager, Community Development, spoke;
  and introduced Baltazar Barrios, Planner, Community Development.

  PowerPoint Presentation.

  Baltazar Barrios, Planner, Community Development, spoke.
